title: Structured Output — JSON Schema Quickstart Visuals and Validation UI
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Create a compact, developer-focused quickstart and a set of UI visuals that teach structured output with JSON Schema. The deliverables will be: 1) a 1-page quickstart graphic that explains when to use schema enforcement vs. post-hoc parsing, 2) a three-panel Figma flow showing example schema authoring -> live validation -> sample output preview, and 3) a set of screenshot-ready mockups for the Console 'Validate schema' experience including error explanations and fix suggestions. Scope: examples for generation (chat + completion), function/tool calling, and embeddings metadata. Excludes deep integration work for Private deployments; this ticket focuses on UX assets and copy for docs/console release.
acceptance_criteria:
- One Figma file with organized frames: Quickstart card, Schema editor mock, Validation panel mock, and Example outputs.
- Quickstart graphic exported as PNG and SVG optimized for docs.
- Console mockups include three validation states: valid, recoverable warnings, and fatal errors, with suggested fixes.
- Copy reviewed and approved by PM and Engineering.
- Links to example schemas (chat, completion, tool-calling) included in docs.
- Accessibility check: color contrast for error states and keyboard focus for editor controls documented.

decisions: Use a two-column console layout: left=authoring (inline JSON + templates), right=preview (example outputs + validation results).
Default validation mode in quickstart will be 'warn' for non-fatal mismatches to avoid blocking first-time users; fatal errors required for schema-critical fields.
Include pre-built example schemas: chat-reply-schema, tool-call-schema, embedding-metadata-schema. These will be small and opinionated rather than exhaustive.
Provide a one-click 'Try with examples' button that populates both schema and sample input to show immediate validation feedback.

notes_for_engineering: Validator needs to return structured failure codes and suggested fixes. Include an API to request up to 3 example inputs that should pass the schema for preview. Runtime constraints: max schema size ~64KB; heavy keywords (patternProperties) will show a performance warning in the UI.
ux_constraints: Keep quickstart to a single visual card with <250 words. Ensure high-contrast color tokens for error/warn/ok states and that keyboard navigation supports editor controls.
